Container.Name: cairn
Container.Overview: Shared project memory for AI coding agents. Serves an MCP endpoint and a dashboard (live request feed, graph explorer, Cypher console) backed by your Neo4j. On first start the log prints a one-time code: use it at the WebUI to create the admin account.

Config.Name: Neo4j URI
Config.Description: Address of your Neo4j (bolt://host:7687). Inside Docker, localhost is the container itself: use the address the container can reach.

Config.Name: Static token (optional)
Config.Description: Normally leave empty and create tokens in the dashboard (Access).

Config.Name: Capture mode
Config.Description: full keeps request and response payloads in memory for the dashboard; meta keeps only a summary.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 only if a proxy you control sets X-Forwarded-For.
